access_points.name: plate_slot_access
access_points.description: Top SBS microplate pickup/drop-off position on the shaker table in the documented zero position for robotic gripping.

notes: No openly accessible vendor CAD/STL/GLB for the BioShake or an INHECO Thermoshake AC was found during web search, so the mesh uses a generated fallback box based on official dimensions.
The bio_shake backend appears generic/QInstruments-derived; per task guidance this package uses an INHECO-style single-plate thermoshaker as the closest representative physical model.
The access frame is centered on the top contact surface height from the official spec; clamp pins, vents, and side panel details are not modeled in the STL.
